selection: lowest recorded Facturation validation semantic loss
prerequisites: Successful reviewed focused rehearsal and export/Colibri comparison; original selected R11 base, never disposable rehearsal weights.
Complete exactly one focused training epoch, 1047 updates, with all original training rows retained.
Freeze this policy and validation inputs before training; do not select checkpoints using acceptance data.
Baseline reuse requires identical inputs, source/runtime/model artifacts, inference settings and complete verified prior events.

Only the selected changed candidate may advance; retain baseline if it wins. A loss-only tie-break does not establish an accuracy gain. Run the full three-app validation regression, 438 frozen regressions and 48 additional controls separately.
Facturation must pass all of its critical, subset, full-action, tool, exact-argument and structure gates. Recheck MP/DW before considering activation.
No production activation or later-application training follows development selection.
limitations: Development rows include neutral-history variants; scenario groups do not establish independence.
These rows have no explicit language labels; no per-language score is inferred.
Repeated regression and additional control inputs remain excluded from training and checkpoint selection.
No accuracy improvement or 95 percent result is predicted by this policy.
